html:
The Nor Rel Muk are a Wintu people of the Hayfork Valley and upper Trinity River country in Trinity County, northern California. They are one of several Wintu groups, along with the Northern Wintu, the Dau Pom and the Winnimem.

They lived in small villages, fishing salmon, gathering acorns and hunting deer. The Gold Rush reached the Trinity River in 1848, and miners and settlers killed many Wintu in the years that followed. The Nor Rel Muk Nation today seeks recognition from the US government.
